current_upstream_s3_hal.local_idf_agrees: The installed ESP-IDF 5.5.5 S3 HAL has the same unsupported/empty paths; spi_master rejects SPI_SAMPLING_POINT_PHASE_1.

upstream_espressif_review.decision: No source-supported, ADS1262-compatible sampling-point change or upstream fix was identified for a repo-local patch. Do not use unsupported PHASE_1, change SPI mode, exceed datasheet clocks, correct CRC bits, or repeat the failed NOP/duty experiments.
upstream_espressif_review.remaining_hypothesis: Late final-bit sampling after DOUT takes its readiness/idle role is consistent with the observed final-bit-only errors but is not established by this other-chip issue. The single observed 1-to-0 corruption also prevents claiming the line is always forced high.
upstream_espressif_review.next_evidence: An independently bounded pulse/holding-register diagnostic or physical SCLK/DOUT/DRDY waveform comparison can distinguish tail readiness from general link timing. Such reads remain diagnostic, never bypass generation freshness, and never become scientific frames.
